decisions.adopted_constraint: Document logically distinct roles, assigned responsibility, delegation, and oversight without assigning a real person.
A future role assignment requires documented qualification and training proportional to the authorized duties.
Represent role-aware access, blinding state, and append-only premature-access receipts; unknown or positive exposure fails closed.
Combine explicit separated duties, minimum access, protected event histories, and complete actor/time/source/outcome metadata.
Freeze a content identity before outcome-relevant search and represent later changes as separate versions, not edits in place.
Record the nature, timing, reason, decision authority, exposure state, and independent review status of every material deviation.
Treat unresolved role conflicts and prior or connected exposure as contamination states requiring recusal or a future owner-approved disposition.
Material disputes and substantive amendments require a logically independent evaluator without unresolved conflicts or content influence.
Collect the minimum authorized metadata, assess privacy prospectively, and restrict access even when identifiers are opaque.
Separate custody from authorship and review; use inventory, secure sequestration, supervised access, digests, and append-only events.

Expose unresolved owner decisions about voluntariness, understandable consent, undue influence, fair payment, partial payment, withdrawal, and role conflicts without drafting text or taking human action.
Record actor, tool, model, session, retrieval, source, purpose, input class, output class, and access provenance for any future non-content tool use; models cannot author or revise construct content.
Preserve original freezes, results, deviations, and superseding exploratory versions; null, weak, unstable, or nonreplicating outcomes cannot repair the original in place.
Keep pre-freeze content outside AstroHD-exposed repository and contexts, freeze independent conception before specific search, and keep mapping later, separate, and closed.
Any AstroHD-exposed person, conversation, repository context, connected evidence source, model, or model session is ineligible to originate or revise construct content.
Keep all human, population, recruitment, compensation, burden, custody, failure, reliability, and mapping progression choices explicitly unselected.

strongest_external_baseline: Compose current role, training, masking, least-privilege, audit, immutable-registration, deviation, privacy, custody, conflict, human-protection, and provenance standards; keep the AstroHD-specific information firewall explicit as a project adaptation.
